1: -module(feed_SUITE).
    2: -moduledoc """
    3: Dissemination feed (F1) integration: **a follower follows live commits over the feed**, on genuine
    4: loopback QUIC. A founder (`mode=create`, N=1) founds `feed:f1` and commits a fact; a second node
    5: (`mode=join`) catches up to that height and reaches `ready` (a read-only observer). Both then join the
    6: namespace **Brahms overlay**, and the founder commits a NEW fact. Because the follower is already settled
    7: and does not re-enter boot recovery — and its digest rounds are pinned far out, so the digest→pull path can't
    8: recover the block instead — the only way its height can advance is the **eager push**: the founder's
    9: `m:quod_feed` pushes the fresh block to its overlay view, the follower verifies the block's quorum cert
   10: against the committee it holds, hands it to `m:quod_simplex`, and advances — proving the committee→crowd
   11: push path end to end. The second case proves the complementary **digest → verified pull** recovery,
   12: overlay-less.
   13: """.
   14: -include_lib("common_test/include/ct.hrl").
   15: -include_lib("stdlib/include/assert.hrl").
   16: -import(quod_ct, [eventually/2, match_ok/1, ordinary_write_ok/1]).
   17: 
   18: -export([all/0, init_per_suite/1, end_per_suite/1]).
   19: -export([follower_follows_live/1, follower_recovers_gap_via_anti_entropy/1]).
   20: 
   21: -define(NS, <<"feed:f1">>).
   22: -define(FOUNDER_PORT, 15610).
   23: -define(FOLLOWER_PORT, 15611).
   24: -define(AE_FOUNDER_PORT, 15612).
   25: -define(AE_FOLLOWER_PORT, 15613).
   26: 
   27: all() -> [follower_follows_live, follower_recovers_gap_via_anti_entropy].
   28: 
   29: %%%===================================================================
   30: %%% setup: found N=1 + a fact, a mode=join follower catches up, then both join the overlay
   31: %%%===================================================================
   32: 
   33: init_per_suite(Config) ->
   34:     [{FPub, _} = FKey, {JPub, _} = JKey] = [quod_identity:generate() || _ <- [f, j]],
   35:     FAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?FOUNDER_PORT},
   36:     JAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?FOLLOWER_PORT},
   37: 
   38:     %% 1. founder: N=1, commit one fact (slot 2).
   39:     Founder = start_node(?FOUNDER_PORT, FKey, Config, #{mode => create, committee => []}),
   40:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(Founder) =:= 1 end, 10000)),
   41:     ?assert(eventually(
   42:               fun() ->
   43:                       ordinary_write_ok(
   44:                         prove(Founder,
   45:                               {assertz, {capital, france, paris}}))
   46:               end, 20000)),
   47:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(Founder) =:= 2 end, 10000)),
   48: 
   49:     %% 2. follower: mode=join, catches up to the founder's height (2), then settles (`syncing=false`).
   50:     %% Pin this pair's digest rounds far out FIRST: `follower_follows_live` proves the eager-PUSH path,
   51:     %% and a digest round racing the push would recover the block by pull instead — stealing the ingest
   52:     %% the case asserts (the digest→pull path has its own case below, on its own nodes).
   53:     GH = peer:call(Founder, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS]),
   54:     ?assert(is_binary(GH)),
   55:     ok = peer:call(Founder, application, set_env, [quod, feed_anti_entropy_ms, 600000]),
   56:     Follower = start_node(?FOLLOWER_PORT, JKey, Config,
   57:                           #{mode => join, genesis_hash => GH, seed_peers => [FAddr]}),
   58:     ok = peer:call(Follower, application, set_env, [quod, feed_anti_entropy_ms, 600000]),
   59:     ok = peer:call(Founder,  quod_quic, learn, [JPub, JAddr]),
   60:     ok = peer:call(Follower, quod_quic, learn, [FPub, FAddr]),
   61:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(Follower) =:= 2 end, 30000)),
   62:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> maps:get(syncing, status(Follower), true) =:= false end, 30000)),
   63: 
   64:     %% 3. both join the namespace Brahms overlay (address-based), seeded to each other. The seed IS the
   65:     %% initial view, so the founder's eager-push reaches the follower without waiting for a gossip round.
   66:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Founder,  quod_brahms, start_namespace, [?NS, #{node_id => FAddr, seed_peers => [JAddr]}]),
   67:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Follower, quod_brahms, start_namespace, [?NS, #{node_id => JAddr, seed_peers => [FAddr]}]),
   68:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> lists:member(JAddr, peer:call(Founder, quod_brahms, view, [?NS])) end, 15000)),
   69: 
   70:     [{founder, Founder}, {follower, Follower}, {jpub, JPub} | Config].
   71: 
   72: end_per_suite(Config) ->
   73:     _ = [catch peer:stop(P) || P <- [?config(founder, Config), ?config(follower, Config)]],
   74:     ok.
   75: 
   76: %%%===================================================================
   77: %%% test
   78: %%%===================================================================
   79: 
   80: follower_follows_live(Config) ->
   81:     Founder  = ?config(founder, Config),
   82:     Follower = ?config(follower, Config),
   83: 
   84:     %% sanity: the follower is a caught-up NON-member read observer, sitting at the snapshot height.
   85:     ?assertEqual(2, slot(Follower)),
   86:     ?assertEqual(false, maps:get(syncing, status(Follower), true)),
   87:     ?assertNot(lists:member(?config(jpub, Config), peer:call(Follower, quod_simplex, committee, [?NS]))),
   88: 
   89:     %% the founder commits a NEW fact (slot 3) — the feed eager-pushes it to the overlay.
   90:     ?assert(eventually(
   91:               fun() ->
   92:                       ordinary_write_ok(
   93:                         prove(Founder,
   94:                               {assertz, {capital, spain, madrid}}))
   95:               end, 20000)),
   96:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(Founder) =:= 3 end, 10000)),
   97: 
   98:     %% the follower advances to 3 via the FEED (it is settled and never re-runs boot-sync), and the fact
   99:     %% is readable from its OWN kb — the block was applied, not merely stored.
  100:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(Follower) =:= 3 end, 30000)),
  101:     ?assertEqual(false, maps:get(syncing, status(Follower), true)),   %% never dropped back into syncing
  102:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> match_ok(prove(Follower, {capital, spain, {'X'}})) end, 15000)),
  103: 
  104:     %% and it stayed a non-voter — dissemination is read-tier, never promotion.
  105:     ?assertNot(lists:member(?config(jpub, Config), peer:call(Follower, quod_simplex, committee, [?NS]))),
  106: 
  107:     %% the feed recorded the ingest (relayed a verified block into consensus).
  108:     FS = peer:call(Follower, quod_feed, stats, [?NS]),
  109:     ?assertMatch(#{ingested := N} when N >= 1, FS).
  110: 
  111: %% A follower recovers a block it MISSED on the push, purely via anti-entropy — with NO overlay at all.
  112: %% The founder commits the extra block while the follower has an empty Brahms view (no eager-push can
  113: %% reach it); the follower is settled and does not re-run cold-start catch-up, so the only path to the
  114: %% missed block is its periodic digest to the COMMITTEE → the founder's ahead-reply → verified pull.
  115: %% (These are the same digests admission's `peer_ready` gate reads.) Self-contained nodes.
  116: follower_recovers_gap_via_anti_entropy(Config) ->
  117:     {FPub, _} = FKey = quod_identity:generate(),
  118:     {JPub, _} = JKey = quod_identity:generate(),
  119:     FAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?AE_FOUNDER_PORT},
  120:     JAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?AE_FOLLOWER_PORT},
  121:     Founder  = start_node(?AE_FOUNDER_PORT, FKey, Config, #{mode => create, committee => []}),
  122:     try
  123:         ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(Founder) =:= 1 end, 10000)),
  124:         ?assert(eventually(
  125:                   fun() ->
  126:                           ordinary_write_ok(
  127:                             prove(Founder,
  128:                                   {assertz, {capital, italy, rome}}))
  129:                   end, 20000)),
  130:         ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(Founder) =:= 2 end, 10000)),
  131:         GH = peer:call(Founder, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS]),
  132:         F2 = start_node(?AE_FOLLOWER_PORT, JKey, Config, #{mode => join, genesis_hash => GH, seed_peers => [FAddr]}),
  133:         try
  134:             ok = peer:call(F2, application, set_env, [quod, feed_anti_entropy_ms, 500]),
  135:             ok = peer:call(Founder, quod_quic, learn, [JPub, JAddr]),
  136:             ok = peer:call(F2,      quod_quic, learn, [FPub, FAddr]),
  137:             ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(F2) =:= 2 end, 30000)),
  138:             ?assert(eventually(fun() -> maps:get(syncing, status(F2), true) =:= false end, 30000)),
  139: 
  140:             %% commit the delta — the eager-push has an empty view and reaches nobody; recovery must come
  141:             %% from the digest exchange alone.
  142:             ?assert(eventually(
  143:                       fun() ->
  144:                               ordinary_write_ok(
  145:                                 prove(Founder,
  146:                                       {assertz, {capital, japan, tokyo}}))
  147:                       end, 20000)),
  148:             ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(Founder) =:= 3 end, 10000)),
  149:             ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(F2) =:= 3 end, 30000)),          %% recovered via digest → pull
  150:             ?assert(eventually(fun() -> match_ok(prove(F2, {capital, japan, {'X'}})) end, 15000)),
  151:             ?assertNot(lists:member(JPub, peer:call(F2, quod_simplex, committee, [?NS]))),
  152:             FS = peer:call(F2, quod_feed, stats, [?NS]),
  153:             ?assertMatch(#{pulled := N} when N >= 1, FS)
  154:         after
  155:             _ = catch peer:stop(F2)
  156:         end
  157:     after
  158:         _ = catch peer:stop(Founder)
  159:     end.
  160: 
  161: %%%===================================================================
  162: %%% node harness (one OS node each; own identity + QUIC listener)
  163: %%%===================================================================
  164: 
  165: start_node(Port, {Pub, Seed}, Config, Extra) ->
  166:     Name = list_to_atom("feed_" ++ integer_to_list(Port)),
  167:     {ok, Peer, _Node} = peer:start(
  168:                           #{name => Name, connection => standard_io, args => ["-pa" | code:get_path()]}),
  169:     _ = peer:call(Peer, logger, set_primary_config, [level, warning]),
  170:     _ = peer:call(Peer, application, load, [quod]),
  171:     KeyTerm = quod_identity:key_term({Pub, Seed}),
  172:     Set = fun(K, V) -> ok = peer:call(Peer, application, set_env, [quod, K, V]) end,
  173:     Set(listen_port,   Port),
  174:     Set(node_addr,     {"127.0.0.1", Port}),
  175:     Set(node_pubkey,   Pub),
  176:     Set(identity_key,  KeyTerm),
  177:     Set(identity_cert, quod_identity:mint_cert({Pub, Seed})),
  178:     DataDir = filename:join(
  179:                 ?config(priv_dir, Config),
  180:                 "data_" ++ integer_to_list(Port)),
  181:     Set(effect_journal_data_dir, DataDir),
  182:     Set(foreign_log, #{cache_dir => filename:join(DataDir, "foreign-history")}),
  183:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, application, ensure_all_started, [quod]),
  184:     Cfg = maps:merge(#{node_id => Pub, identity => #{pubkey => Pub, key => KeyTerm}, data_dir => DataDir},
  185:                      Extra),
  186:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace, [?NS, Cfg]),
  187:     Peer.
  188: 
  189: %%%===================================================================
  190: %%% helpers
  191: %%%===================================================================
  192: 
  193: status(Peer)      -> peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, status, [?NS]).
  194: slot(Peer)        -> maps:get(slot, status(Peer), -1).
  195: prove(Peer, Goal) -> quod_ct:peer_prove(Peer, ?NS, Goal).
